name: urbanflow-repository-tools
description: Repository quality tools; application runtimes are introduced separately.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:md && npm run lint:html
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint
scripts.check:python: uv run --locked ruff format --check . && uv run --locked ruff check . && uv run --locked pytest
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run check:python
